description: Story Phase 9: chapter 59 has begun.
Ned saw land through the hull: Crownskull Isle (pale beach, reefs, jungle, cliffs, a ridge like a skull with a crown on).
The island is the one on the captain's treasure map (the Crimson Chart). MY treasure.
The Great Sharkstorm followed the Revenge to Crownskull Isle ('Strong scent').
Story Phase 9: chapter 60 has begun.
Chapter 60: the council round the Crimson Chart.
Chapter 60: the 'Beach' way ashore was discussed (and rejected).
Chapter 60: the 'Row' way ashore was discussed (and rejected).
Chapter 60: the 'Swim' way ashore was discussed (and rejected).
Chapter 60: the 'Circle' way ashore was discussed (and rejected).
Chapter 60: the 'Wait' way ashore was discussed (and rejected).
Chapter 60: the 'Lure' way ashore was discussed (and rejected).
Garrick revived the Grand Sharkmaster: 'That's why you're understaffed.'
Story Phase 9: chapter 61 has begun.
Pete was appointed GRAND SHARKMASTER, at random, against his will. A mock title: his class is unchanged. Garrick considers it valid; Pete has 'resigned'.
The second sash of the discount two-pack: sky blue, GRAND SHARKMASTER painted on it.
Pete is wearing the blue sash, for now.
Pete refused the blue sash (floor, water barrel, bilge) and tore up GRAND SHARKMASTER = PETE (there's a copy).
Chapter 61: GRAND SHARKMASTER = PETE, torn to confetti.
Chapter 61: 'I HAVE BEEN GRAND SHARKMASTER FOR FORTY SECONDS!'
Chapter 61: watched the Frog Tax Man's sharkstorm episode on the Mark II.
The Frog Tax Man: Franklin's records eaten by a shark in a shark storm, the morning the Revenge raised Crownskull Isle with the Great Sharkstorm behind it. A coincidence.
Pete's plan (lee side, decoy, lure, the boats), done in fury, is good.
Story Phase 9: chapter 62 has begun.
Chapter 62: the Revenge brought round to the lee side.
Chapter 62: the lines made fast.
Chapter 62: the decoy boat rigged (empty).
Chapter 62: the window found (the decoy drew the sharks off).
Chapter 62: the reeking timber thrown as a lure.
Chapter 62: the boats lowered; rowing for the beach.
The captain has landed on Crownskull Isle (the reef passage done).
Landed on Crownskull Isle: the island is a permanent, explorable location.
Story Phase 9: chapter 67 has begun.
Chapter 67: the western beach (the storm was there too).
The crew took shelter in the ruins on Crownskull Isle.
Chapter 67: shelter job done: Stone.
Chapter 67: shelter job done: Brace.
Chapter 67: shelter job done: Beam.
Chapter 67: shelter job done: Cloth.
Chapter 67: Squawks put in the safest corner of the shelter.
The ruins shelter was made (a stone, a brace, a beam, a wet cloth: emotionally useful) and Squawks put in its safest corner.
Story Phase 9: chapter 68 has begun.
THE GRAND EXCAVATION: the largest excavation blast so far. Seven floors gone; a palm tree airborne; the clearing now a crater.
The Great Sharkstorm smelled the new stench and came inland over Crownskull Isle; great whites fell on the island.
Chapter 68: back to Squawks through the great-white rain.
A megalodon was thrown out of the storm into the lagoon on Crownskull Isle: stranded, alive, persistent.
Story Phase 9: chapter 69 has begun.
For one moment the blast WORKED: the Crimson Fortune lay exposed in the crater.
The Great Sharkstorm is TREASURE-LADEN: most of the Crimson Fortune goes round inside it, much of it worn by sharks.
The blast kept going: the Crimson Fortune was blown up the column into the Great Sharkstorm.
The Crimson King's Crown fell out of the storm and landed on the megalodon's head. Crooked. A perfect fit.
After the Grand Excavation the Grand Stenchmaster is caked in sand and clay, crown crooked.
Chapter 69: Squawks back in the captain's pouch.
What was left in the crater (about two per cent of the Fortune) is contaminated, through and through.
Chapter 69: the crowned megalodon looked at (and the jewelled sharks).
Story Phase 9: chapter 70 has begun.
The Shark Shanty happened in the captain's furious imagination (the sharks were not singing; sharks don't sing).
Chapter 70: Garrick confronted ('vertical relocation').
RECOVER THE CRIMSON FORTUNE: from the Great Sharkstorm, the sharks and the crowned megalodon. Not resolved.
Story Phase 9 is complete: the Crimson Fortune was found and blown into the Great Sharkstorm; RECOVER THE CRIMSON FORTUNE is open (not resolved).
Story Phase 9: chapter 63 has begun.
Chapter 63: the map read on the beach; everyone spread out.
Story Phase 9: chapter 64 has begun.
Found the clearing under the skull: the X on the map.
THE FORTUNE OF THE CRIMSON KINGS: the marker stone cleared, the inscription read. Beneath seven floors.
Chapter 64: Pete said what they'd do with their share.
Chapter 64: Bob said what they'd do with their share.
Chapter 64: Jim said what they'd do with their share.
Chapter 64: Gristle said what they'd do with their share.
Chapter 64: Ned said what they'd do with their share.
The captain promised Squawks a share: a gold pouch of his own. (Important.)
Garrick's Grand Stenchmaster bonus, ceremonial percentage and fart royalty: denied.
Story Phase 9: chapter 65 has begun.
Chapter 65: the digging tools fetched.
Garrick dug three shovelfuls in two or three minutes and thought it was forty hours.
The dig began (the first floor, loose sand).
Story Phase 9: chapter 66 has begun.
STENCHMASTER EXCAVATION TECHNOLOGY: proposed, and refused (NO).
The launch commands were sent ('Internal Stenchmaster operations'). Launch command acknowledged. It could not be stopped.
The Grand Excavation release was triggered: canonically inevitable.
Told where Story Phase 9 starts (your bunk), once, on coming into the barracks after Phase 8.
Story Phase 9 has begun: the morning after the Grand Nap (Garrick's 'Completely Authentic' History; the Grand Sharkmaster; Crownskull Isle; the Grand Treasure Catastrophe).
Chapter 55: saw how Pete slept.
Chapter 55: saw how Bob slept.
Chapter 55: saw how Gristle slept.
Chapter 55: saw how Jim slept.
THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND NAP HAS CONCLUDED. He was the only person who actually slept.
The captain, eerily calm, asked to hear the history of the sash. Garrick was delighted. The crew knew it was bait.
Story Phase 9: chapter 56 has begun.
Garrick's claim (not history): the Grand Stenchmasters guard the Sacred Stench; six duties; at least a thousand years old; no evidence ('very private').
Garrick's claim (invented that morning): Princess Stenchalina the First, the first Grand Stenchmaster; the disaster was that her ribbon fluttered.
Garrick's claim: the Five Grand Treasures (the Crown made yesterday, the galley chair, Jim's mixing bowl, the television 'spiritually', the discount sash).
Garrick's claim (fiction): Sir Stenchalot the Flatulent, Lady Windbottom the Mighty, Grand Duke Gassius the Loud, Admiral Rumpus Thunderpants and the Battle of the Seven Winds.
A CLEARANCE sticker was seen inside the sash's hem (Pete noticed; the captain said nothing).
Garrick's claim: the Sacred Sash Bearers hold the sash during a major release (Pete: so it's a fart sash in his own story).
The trap: 'especially the part about the seventy-per-cent-off discount bin.' The sash's true origin put to Garrick, awake.
Chapter 56: the discount-bin trap sprung.
Story Phase 9: chapter 57 has begun.
Chapter 57: Pete gave evidence (NO RECEIPT).
Chapter 57: Gristle gave evidence (NO RECEIPT).
Chapter 57: Bob gave evidence (NO RECEIPT).
Chapter 57: Squawks gave evidence (NO RECEIPT).
NO RECEIPT. Garrick's defence: spiritual age (bought last week materially, ancient symbolically). Then the plain purpose: somebody holds it while he farts.
The third Lost Fart attempt (in Bob's explorer's helmet), shouted down: discount store, seven days, bargain-bin employees.
Chapter 57: Garrick took Bob's explorer's helmet (Bob's rid of it now).
The explorer's helmet is back in the costume trunk (the captain sat on the lid).
Story Phase 9: chapter 58 has begun.
Chapter 58: Bob resigned in advance.
Bob resigned from the Grand Assistant job before he was appointed to it.
The Grand Stenchmaster's Grand Stenchmaster Sash's Grand Assistant; the Grand Steward; the org chart (Senior Flutter Observer, fifteen feet away). None of these jobs exist.
Chapter 58: the sash organisation chart (the board by the barrels).
Squawks was offered Ceremonial Sash Herald. The captain protected him from employment. Squawks: 'No job.'
In plain words: 'I want somebody to hold the sash so it doesn't flutter while I fart.' FINALLY. FART SASH HOLDER.
Looked out from the ridge path (the Revenge at anchor; the storm standing off).
Recover the Crimson Fortune: the Crimson King's Crown is back (not yet: for later).
Recover the Crimson Fortune: the treasure the sharks are wearing is back (not yet).
Recover the Crimson Fortune: the loose treasure in the Great Sharkstorm is back (not yet).
Recover the Crimson Fortune: the Great Sharkstorm dealt with (not yet).
